text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: inference-runtime-prod - elevated 5xx rate and growing queue depth on /v1/generate. Sustained error rate ~7% over 2m, p95 latency climbing. Auto-escalation to eng-oncall.

maria: I see it. Starting triage. checking kube and runtime metrics. tagging infra.

ashwin: oncall infra here — I have dashboards open (queue_length, inflight, kernel-time). Looks like the max_in_flight for gpt-q8 layer has saturated. KV cache pressure is high.

jordan: any customer-facing impact numbers? cs team?

linda: from CS: a few customers on high-QPS keys reporting intermittent 500s and truncated streams. No major accounts fully down but error spikes hitting feature flags.

maria: ok, mitigation plan: 1) quick traffic shaping: apply global soft rate-limit (reduce per-key burst) 2) shed heavy requests (reranking/long-context) 3) reduce max_in_flight for that pod pool to relieve event loop 4) lower request timeout to 15s for streaming to force faster failover.

ashwin: I can push rate-limit via gateway now. Suggest incremental: drop from 120r/s -> 60r/s for anonymous keys, 120->90 for tiered keys. Also will throttle requests with >2048 tokens to a lower concurrency class.

maria: please do it and post commands.

ashwin: running patch now:
```bash
# gateway rate limit patch
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/ratelimit/apply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRATOKEN" \
  -d '{"scope":"runtime-prod","rules":[{"matcher":"key_tier==anonymous","burst":30,"rate":60},{"matcher":"key_tier==standard","burst":45,"rate":90}]}'
```

ashwin: applied. Confirming counters... rate drops observed at edge.

maria: next, feature-shedding: disable experimental reranker v2 (high-cost). That should cut some heavy APLs. Who can toggle feature flag?

leo: I can flip it, doing feature flag off for runtime-prod.

leo: toggled ff:neranker_v2 -> off. propagation ~20s.

jordan: oncall-bot: can we lower max_in_flight for pods in runtime-pool-b? short command?

oncall-bot: suggested command:
```yaml
# patch to deployment to reduce concurrency
kubectl -n runtime-prod patch deploy runtime-pool-b --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/CONCURRENCY","value":"12"}]'
```

ashwin: applying reduced concurrency patch to pool-b now. Will restart pods gradually (rolling).

maria: also adjust server timeout for streaming routes to 15s to reduce stuck connections. ashwin can push that to config.

ashwin: pushed timeout change to envoy config and runtime-config: stream_timeout_ms=15000.

linda: CS update: customer A saw error rate drop to ~2.5% after flag toggle + rate-limit. They're appreciative.

emma: any impact on latency or CPU after these changes? Need to track.

ashwin: initial metrics: queue_length down ~45%, p95 token time down 18%, CPU for pool-b reduced by ~22%. No increased errors elsewhere observed.

maria: good. We should also temporarily adjust quota/quota-buckets for the very high QPS keys: reduce daily burst allotment and enable stricter enforcement to prevent re-exacerbation. jordan, can you prepare the list of top offending keys?

jordan: extracting top keys by qps now. Sending list in DM to maria and ashwin.

maria: putting a temporary incident note: mitigation applied: global rate-limits tightened, reranker_v2 disabled, pool-b concurrency reduced, stream timeout shortened, targeted key throttles pending. Customer impact: degraded streaming and 5xx up to 7% -> now ~1-3% for affected customers. Next actions: monitor for 30m, finalize key throttles, plan durable config (increase capacity autoscale or optimize kernel path). Handoff to next oncall in 20m.

leo: thumbs on infra changes. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder: next-rotation @ashwin will be oncall at 1717203660.

ashwin: I'll pick up the rest of the follow-ups. Quick checklist I'll own: - finalize key throttles - run a targeted batch to clear KV cache pressure - schedule a follow-up runbook update to include 'reranker sheddable' in future incidents.

maria: handing off to ashwin in 15. If anything spikes, page immediately. Otherwise I'll close the incident after 30m of stability.

linda: CS will notify affected customers of mitigation and that we're monitoring.

maria: thanks all. Closing on-call thread for now, leaving notes in incident tracker.
